limits: Legacy atomic replacement is implemented and exercised on Unix/macOS; other platforms refuse legacy rewrite. Fresh sealed current-format reads and writes remain portable but were exercised only on this Mac.
Tests use actual redb files and signed synthetic histories, not user vault data. This receipt does not claim bulk migration of every existing user store or historical receipt fixture.

The clean marker is an owner assertion within a trusted directory. Older writers, raw backend mutations, same-space replay and hostile directory owners remain outside its assurance.
Replacement excludes obsolete plaintext pages from the new active file. It does not erase backups, snapshots, old copies, SSD remnants or prior encrypted epoch-key pages.
Only the pinned backend logical table is copied. No support for arbitrary extra raw redb tables is claimed.
No native GUI, physical-peer/device, independent second-host, non-Unix migration or declared-MSRV run is claimed.
